notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Features

 Adds the ability to adjust village farmer behavior in the Options menu. You can now toggle the following tasks on or off: sow seeds, water fields, and harvest crops.

Bug Fixes

 Adjusted the volume of certain lines for Zaza and Woolby in Japanese.
 The Sacred Sword can now harvest crops over a wider range.
 Added new warp points for Spring Village's and Autumn Village's development zones.
 Fixed a bug where players could not obtain the Evasive Leg Guards. You can now purchase them at blacksmiths once your village level is high enough.
 Fixed a bug where the ema plaque request "The Divine Sword Dance is the Best!" would not be available.
 Adjusted the Blade Shard drop rate so you can now obtain them from high-level toad and fallen warrior enemies.
 Fixed bugs that halted progression during certain Bonding Quests.
 Fixed a crash bug upon start-up caused by failure to obtain display information.
 Minor bug fixes

Thank you for your patience while we address these issues. Please stay tuned for any additional updates.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Adjusted the frequency of certain Woolby voice lines.

Fixed an issue where player names could not include character names from the game.

Fixed an issue in which certain Bonding Quests and main story quests could not progress.

Fixed an issue in which some Ema Plaque Requests and Village Missions could not be completed.

Fixed an issue where the Sacred Treasure "Parasol" could not ride updrafts when the framerate was too high.

Art book and soundtrack were updated with minor corrections.

Other minor fixes and adjustments.

Thank you for your patience while we address these issues. Please stay tuned for any additional updates.

notes.title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma is Available Now!

Fifty years since the Celestial Collapse, a new story of interwoven fates begins as Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma launches on PC! 

[previewyoutube=zMBEXRGat4s;full][/previewyoutube]

Start your journey in this bold reimagining of the beloved series, which transports you to the eastern lands of Azuma for the first time in series history. 

Available in a standard edition for $59.99; a Digital Deluxe edition, which includes the game, the “Seasons of Love Bundle,” and the “Festive Attire and Dark Woolby Bundle” for $69,98; or as a Super Digital Deluxe edition, which includes the game, the “Seasons of Love Bundle,” the “Festive Attire and Dark Woolby Bundle,” a digital soundtrack, and digital art book, for $79.98, there’s no shortage of ways to embark on this new adventure.
